meaning:
συγγένεια, -ας, ἡ
(συγγενής), [in LXX chiefly for מִשְׁפָּחָה ;]
1. kinship.
2. By meton., kinsfolk, kindred: Luk.1:61, Act.7:3, 14 †
(AS)

elsewhere.note: They said to her, “There is no one among your relatives who is called by this name.”
and said to him, ‘Get out of your land and away from your relatives, and come into a land which I will show you.’
